We need to respond with exactly one function call. The user wants us to continue on whatever approach we think is suitable. We should probably use task_tracker to plan the work. So we will call task_tracker with command "plan" and a task list describing the steps to implement the SQL query engine.

We must output in the proper format: a function call JSON.

Thus:

{
  "command": "plan",
  "task_list": [
    "Analyze the overall architecture and interfaces defined in the existing codebase",
    "Implement the SQL lexer in src/sql/parser/lexer.rs",
    "Implement the SQL parser in src/sql/parser/parser.rs",
    "Implement the query planner in src/sql/planner/planner.rs",
    "Implement plan nodes and execution dispatch in src/sql/planner/plan.rs",
    "Implement query optimizer in src/sql/planner/optimizer.rs",
    "Implement the query executor in src/sql/execution/executor.rs",
    "Implement session management in src/sql/execution/session.rs",
    "Implement the aggregator for aggregate functions in src/sql/execution/aggregator.rs",
    "Implement join logic in src/sql/execution/join.rs",
    "Implement the local SQL engine bridging in src/sql/engine/local.rs",
    "Add core scalar built-in functions (length, lower, upper, trim, abs, round, ceil, floor, coalesce, nullif, now)",
    "Implement CASE expression support",
    "Implement IN and BETWEEN predicates",
    "Implement EXISTS and scalar subqueries",
    "Implement non‑recursive CTEs (WITH clause)",
    "Implement UNION ALL and UNION operators",
    "Implement UPSERT (ON CONFLICT) semantics",
    "Implement CHECK constraint evaluation",
    "Implement basic ALTER TABLE operations",
    "Implement window functions (row_number, rank, dense_rank, lag, lead, running aggregates)",
    "Run the full test suite and address any failures",
    "Verify exact output parity with all goldenscript tests"
  ]
}

Make sure to wrap in function call: {"name":"task_tracker","arguments":{"command":"plan","task_list":...}}? Actually the tool expects just the function call with parameters. The format is to output the function call with name and arguments. So we need to output:

{
  "name": "task_tracker",
  "arguments": {
    "command": "plan",
    "task_list": [...]
  }
}

Thus final.
</think>
